highlights.title: A sign-in notice you can close
highlights.line: The warning that your agents' sign-in is ending now floats over the page instead of pushing it down, names the account, and has an X.

highlights.title: Gemini sign-in asks about your data
highlights.line: On a Mac, signing Gemini in with a Google subscription shows Antigravity's terms in Kosmos, and you choose if Google may use your data.

highlights.title: Settings stays clickable
highlights.line: On a long Settings section, the section buttons stay below the top bar instead of sliding under it.

highlights.title: A running agent's files stay safe
highlights.line: Deleting a removed agent's files no longer touches a running agent whose name differs from it only in capitals.
